justification: C-B DCP 11.14 (Riverwood Estate Stage 1) had 218 live area rules with no outline, so no house was served them. The LEP's own 2024 Riverwood amendment polygon (FSR 2.2) is the Stage 1 site: 1.64 ha, edges on the three streets the DCP names.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The keying rule is removed or keys to another id, or the outline file holds another id, or the shared notice file drifts.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: 218 live rows in layer precinct with v2_precinct_id NULL (served to no house); dry run keys 253 (218 live + 35 off).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: NSW Planning Portal EPI_Primary_Planning_Layers/1 FSR polygon, AMENDMENT 'State Environmental Planning Policy Amendment (Riverwood) 2024'; NSW_Transport_Theme road centrelines along its edge; DCP 11.14 p5 land sentence.

pre_impl.existing_data: Loader import_cb_centre_boundaries.py already takes LEP polygons as site files (lep_area1_7_4.geojson); keying via constant strategy as cb_11_4_croydon_street.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 2026-10-17 raster fit for 11.14 sat on DP16944 lots about 100 m away and was refused (shape 0.77); the LEP polygon shares 0 m2 with those lots, and its edges run on the named streets.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One outline file, one SITE_IDS entry, one CONFIDENCE method label, one keying rule, one test; Riverwood removed from not-covered and may-apply data.

functions.name: apply_gate_rules
functions.input: the keying rule cb_11_14_riverwood_stage1 run for council canterbury_bankstown
functions.if_none: zero matching rows means nothing is keyed and nothing written

values.read_at: Planning Portal query 2026-10-21, area in MGA56
values.if_missing: no match to the state's 1.6 ha

values.value: edge roads: Belmore Road North 171 m, Roosevelt Avenue 131 m, Washington Avenue 129 m
values.read_at: NSW_Transport_Theme/5 within 15 m of the edge

break_it.scenario: A Riverwood house outside Stage 1 (34 Kentucky Rd) gets the rules.
break_it.what_happens: A house outside the block would be shown rules that are not its own.
break_it.how: Only lots inside the 1.64 ha polygon resolve to 11.14; checked live after the write.
break_it.repro: live for-property for 34 KENTUCKY ROAD RIVERWOOD

break_it.scenario: A house inside Stage 1 does not get them.
break_it.what_happens: A house inside the block would miss the rules written for it.
break_it.how: Loader proof: a point inside resolves to 11.14 by the site's own lookup; live check on an inside point.

break_it.scenario: Riverwood still listed as not mapped or may-apply.
break_it.what_happens: Page says rules are not shown while they are.
break_it.how: Both data files lose the entry; shared files regenerated; drift test.

mutation_analysis: Changing the rule's precinct_id fails the new test.

post_merge.db_reset: Yes: load the outline (import_cb_centre_boundaries.py --src ... --commit, backup written) then derive_precinct_keys.py --council canterbury_bankstown --only cb_11_14_riverwood_stage1 --apply (backup written).
post_merge.manual_verify: Live: a point inside Stage 1 sees the 218 rules; 34 Kentucky Rd Riverwood does not.

residual_risk: Later Riverwood stages, if they get their own DCP chapter, need their own outline.
